title: NextMillionaire
tagline: A simple lottery contract which anyone can join and it picks random winner after the game time ends
description:
A simple solidity smart contract which can be interacted by anyone by depositing the amount and participate in the game and after the time limit, the contract picks the random winner and deposits the funds into his address
Once the game starts nobody able to join the game until the game finishes and after the winning money is transferred, the game state changes to ready and anybody can join this time.
